# Enhanced Keyboard Unlocker **Brings Xiaomi's enhanced keyboard toolbar to every keyboard.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/Mods-Center/Enhanced-keyboard-unlocker?style=for-the-badge&label=release&color=0a84ff)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Enhanced-keyboard-unlocker/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/Mods-Center/Enhanced-keyboard-unlocker/total?style=for-the-badge&color=30d158)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Enhanced-keyboard-unlocker/releases) [![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/Mods-Center/Enhanced-keyboard-unlocker?style=for-the-badge&color=ffd60a)](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Enhanced-keyboard-unlocker/stargazers) [![Telegram](https://img.shields.io/badge/Telegram-channel-26A5E4?style=for-the-badge&logo=telegram&logoColor=white)](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)
## Features - Enhanced keyboard toolbar for all keyboards - Assistant and Notes in the frequent shortcuts - Phrase panel background that follows the keyboard colour - Bottom bar colour fixed for Gboard, and less empty space below the keyboard on Global ROMs - Optional: remove the down arrow below the keyboard (chosen during install) - Works offline: everything is bundled in the module ### Tips - Triple-tap the **Phrase** section to turn dynamic colour on or off (or set `persist.mdc_color_detection` to `true`/`false`). ## Requirements - MIUI or HyperOS - Magisk, KernelSU or APatch ## Installation 1. Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Enhanced-keyboard-unlocker/releases/latest). 2. Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch. 3. Reboot your device. ## Notes - Android 13+: Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module. - If the bottom bar colour is wrong on the newest Gboard, install an older Gboard version. ---
Made by **[🅺🅰🆂🅷🅸](https://t.me/kakashi1v1)** · part of **[Mods Center](https://github.com/Mods-Center)** [Website](https://modscenter.org) · [Channel](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs) · [Support group](https://t.me/bootloop_discussion) · [Report a bug](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Enhanced-keyboard-unlocker/issues)

Enhanced Keyboard Unlocker

Brings Xiaomi's enhanced keyboard toolbar to every keyboard.

![Release](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Enhanced-keyboard-unlocker/releases/latest)

![Downloads](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Enhanced-keyboard-unlocker/releases)

![Stars](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Enhanced-keyboard-unlocker/stargazers)

![Telegram](https://t.me/kashis_cringey_stuffs)

Features

  • Enhanced keyboard toolbar for all keyboards
  • Assistant and Notes in the frequent shortcuts
  • Phrase panel background that follows the keyboard colour
  • Bottom bar colour fixed for Gboard, and less empty space below the keyboard on Global ROMs
  • Optional: remove the down arrow below the keyboard (chosen during install)
  • Works offline: everything is bundled in the module

    • Tips

  • Triple-tap the **Phrase** section to turn dynamic colour on or off (or set `persist.mdc_color_detection` to `true`/`false`).

    • Requirements

  • MIUI or HyperOS
  • Magisk, KernelSU or APatch

    • Installation

  • Download the latest zip from [**Releases**](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Enhanced-keyboard-unlocker/releases/latest).
  • Flash it in Magisk, KernelSU or APatch.
  • Reboot your device.

    • Notes

  • Android 13+: Signature verification must be disabled. Flash [Apk Protection Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Protection-Patch) or [Apk Signature Verification Patch](https://github.com/Mods-Center/Apk-Signature-Verification-Patch) first, or use the Core Patch LSPosed module.
  • If the bottom bar colour is wrong on the newest Gboard, install an older Gboard version.

    • ---
